test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Teachers love their students.

options.text: Students are being loved by their teachers.
Students are loved by their teachers.
Students have been loved by their teachers
Students will be loved by their teachers.

solution:
The solution is **Students are loved by their teachers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that expresses the "*Teachers love their students.*" in passive voice is 
 
• **Passive voice - **If the subject is having the action done to it, then the verb is called *passive voice*.
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about voices :
 
 
• **Passive voice -** If the subject is having the action done to it, then the verb is called ***passive voice***.
 
• **Active ****voice -** If the subject is performing the action, then the verb is called ***active voice.***
 
 
• ***​****For example: **Active voice - **Aditi cut a tree. **Passive voice - **A tree was cut by aditi.*
